messages:
auditor_jane: Quick ask — SOC2 auditor wants proof of an RBAC change that occurred last quarter (who approved, the change diff, and the audit log slice showing the API call). Also need KMS rotation evidence and a short vuln-triage timeline for CVE-2025-3456. Can you assemble?

sam_ops: Which role change specifically? we had a few rolebinding updates in kube and an IAM policy tweak in prod.

auditor_jane: The principal is service-account:renderer@prod, change window 2026-01-05 to 2026-01-12. Approval should be in the PR/approval workflow + manager signoff.

maria_sec: Got it. I can grab the PR, review thread, and manager approval screenshot. For KMS rotation - do you need key material proof (key version history) or just rotation logs?

auditor_jane: Both if possible. Auditor prefers key version history + CloudTrail entries showing RotateKey / UpdateKey operations and the time they took effect. Chain-of-custody hash for exported logs would be ideal.

kevin_sre: I'll export CloudTrail and k8s audit slices. Command I'll run (example):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z --region us-west-2 > /tmp/rotatekey-events.json
kubectl logs -n kube-system audit-collector --since=30d > /tmp/k8s-audit-jan.json
sha256sum /tmp/rotatekey-events.json /tmp/k8s-audit-jan.json > /tmp/export.checksums
```

infra-bot: Export job queued by kevin_sre. job-id=jb-98a3f7. ETA ~2m.

sam_ops: For the RBAC diff — the PR is gitlab.com/redwood/infra/-/merge_requests/512. Change was: added renderer SA to cluster-reader role; approval from @maria_sec on 2026-01-06. I'll attach the PR patch.

maria_sec: CVE-2025-3456 triage: vuln reported 2026-01-08, patch roll on 2026-01-10, canaries 2026-01-11, full deploy 2026-01-12. PagerDuty incident PD-4721 has timeline + bridge link. I'll include remediation notes and rollback plan.

auditor_jane: For chain-of-custody, can you produce a manifest with S3 paths and sha256 values and sign it? auditor will look for unmodified exports + who pulled them.

kevin_sre: We'll create a manifest.csv with columns: path,timestamp,sha256,user. Example line: `s3://redwood-compliance/exports/rotatekey-20260112.json,2026-01-12T14:03:12Z,3b7f...c9a,user:kevin_sre`

sam_ops: I can export the PR approval screenshot and manager email thread. I'll redact personal emails but keep approval headers.

maria_sec: I'll assemble a zip: {rbac-pr.patch,pr-approval.png,cloudtrail-rotatekey.json,k8s-audit-jan.json,pd-4721-timeline.txt,manifest.csv,checksums.asc} and upload to s3 with a presigned read-only link.

auditor_jane: Target timeline? auditor wants this by EOD Friday. Is that doable?

kevin_sre: EOD Friday works. I'll attach checksums and an HMAC signature using our compliance key. Command: `openssl dgst -sha256 -sign /secrets/compliance_key.pem -out manifest.sig manifest.csv`

maria_sec: Confirmed. I'll also add short notes explaining the vulnerability impact and the test signoffs.

auditor_jane: Awesome. Please @ me when uploaded. Also include a brief note on retention policy for these logs (how long they live and where archived).

sam_ops: Will add retention notes: CloudTrail = 7 years (S3 Glacier after 90 days), k8s audit = 2 years in dedicated bucket.

infra-bot: job-id=jb-98a3f7 completed. files: /tmp/rotatekey-events.json (149KB), /tmp/k8s-audit-jan.json (4.1MB), /tmp/export.checksums (128B).

kevin_sre: Uploading bundle to s3://redwood-compliance/tmp/audit-bundle-3956781234.zip and generating presigned URL now.

maria_sec: Bundle assembled and uploaded. Presigned link (expires 72h): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-compliance/audit-bundle-3956781234.zip?signature=redacted

auditor_jane: Received, downloading. Thanks everyone — will follow up if the auditor asks for any clarifications. :thumbsup:
